title: Journal Entry
description: Immutable append-only event journal entry. Every action is a journal entry — nothing happens unrecorded. See Part I §1 of cursor-kit-v2-FINAL.md.

seq.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number within a session.

type.description: Event type — exhaustive list of possible journal events.

source.description: Agent or system component that produced this event (e.g., 'zeus', 'backend', 'qa').

payload.description: Event-specific data. Structure varies by event type.
